description: This file defines the Layout model class for the OpenCart admin design module, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve layout data, routes, and modules from the database.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: This class manages the CRUD operations for layouts, including routes and modules, within the OpenCart admin design module, extending the base System Engine Model.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout entry in the database, optionally adding routes and modules associated with the layout.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout's information, including routes and modules, based on the provided layout ID and data.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Removes a layout and its associated routes and modules, and deletes references in related tables such as categories, products, information, articles, and topics.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific layout by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches a list of layouts, supporting sorting, ordering, and pagination based on the provided filter data.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total number of layouts in the database.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Associates a route with a layout, specifying store ID and route name.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all routes associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes route entries for a given layout ID, including by store or store ID.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all routes associated with a specific layout.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Fetches route entries filtered by store ID.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Associates a module with a layout by inserting it into the layout_module table.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Removes all modules linked to a specific layout.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules associated with a given layout, ordered by position and sort order.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes modules based on their code or pattern matching in the code.
